description_en: Calls the DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection operation to disconnect an endpoint zone connection
description_zh: 调用DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection接口，断开终端节点可用区连接
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink disable-vpc-endpoint-zone-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint connection that you want to reject endpoint connection.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要拒绝终端节点连接的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:
true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is directly performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会拒绝连接请求。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the endpoint connection
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disconnect the legacy connection after smooth migration of EPS resource. Valid values:

true: disconnects the legacy connection.

false (default): does not disconnect the legacy connection.

Set this property to true when you want to disconnect the legacy connection in the endpoint zone after smooth migration of EPS resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否断开平滑迁移后的旧连接。取值：

true：是。

false（默认值）：否。

在资源做平滑迁移后，断开终端节点在此可用区的旧的连接时选择此属性
parameters.name: replaced_resource
